lead: Cinematic noir film still, rainy night, warm amber streetlight, deep shadows, touches of blood red.
notes: Mood-only mini images for Mafia_Takedown.html, beside the lore, game layer and feature text. SDXL (free): gen Mafia_Takedown-mini --model sdxl --max 999, then finish Mafia_Takedown-mini --model sdxl. Each prompt is the section's opening line; the images add flavor and never try to show a mechanic accurately.

images.name: town
images.prompt: A small city street at night run by a gang, shuttered shops and a black car idling outside a bar.

images.name: alias
images.prompt: Photograph of a man in a dark hoodie tying a black cloth mask over his eyes in a dim apartment hallway.

images.name: mask
images.prompt: Photograph of a black cloth mask lying on a wooden kitchen table beside a lit candle and a framed photo.

images.name: room
images.prompt: A dark office floor at night with overturned desks and papers floating in the air after a fight.

images.name: archive
images.prompt: A stack of old newspapers on a desk under a lamp, a front page photo of a ruined building.

images.name: evening
images.prompt: A person resting on a fire escape at night, looking at the city lights, a cup of coffee beside them.

images.name: items
images.prompt: A pile of improvised weapons on a garage floor: a crowbar, a frying pan, a fire axe, a metal pipe.

images.name: limbs
images.prompt: Photograph of a pale plastic mannequin arm lying in a puddle on a wet concrete floor under a flickering lamp.

images.name: gang
images.prompt: A row of thugs in cheap suits waiting in a smoky corridor, holding bats and pipes.

images.name: signals
images.prompt: A spinning circular saw blade throwing sparks in a dark industrial room.
